title: Miss Bess Allen's orphans home school and its music pupils
summary: Bess Allen ran an orphans home with an evening summer music school where Lockwood Lewis taught any instrument. Humes names fellow pupils Dicky Wells, Jonah Jones, Charles Blumer and drummer Bill Beeson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Then in the later years, there was a lady there and she had an orphans home. Her name was Miss Bus Allan, and that's where all of us, if you would go to her school, her summer school in the evening, she had a fellow who would teach you anything you wanted to play.
What's his name, do you remember?

Yeah because we all went to school together.
